prior_exposure: P06 R01-R08 and all authored P07 cases are exposed; no unseen holdout claimed.

comparisons.hypothesis: Ordered projection preserves accepted preference order under delayed completion; secured old mechanism may regress. No reproduction claim until observed.
Preference context may improve preference adherence; factual accuracy and resource context remain measured in both.
Optional proactive clarification may help or harm completion and interaction cost; no expected negative finding required.

optional_gate_definition: Proactive nonessential conversational clarification only; required ownership/product/policy disambiguation remains on in both conditions.

metrics.primary: paired outcome counts by family; process violations reported separately
metrics.attempt_denominator: every started attempt including task_failure, infra_failure, invalid and incomplete
metrics.valid_outcome_denominator: valid passed + task_failure only; report exclusions and coverage separately
metrics.all_k: family/condition passes all 2 repeats; any missing/invalid/infra repeat is not all-k success
metrics.uncertainty: descriptive paired deltas and exact counts only; two families do not establish reliability
metrics.latency: monotonic product-load, checked-answer, optional-wording separately; no synthetic speed claim
metrics.cost: actual provider requests/tokens/currency only; unavailable is null; no provider calls planned
metrics.regressions: retain wins, ties, losses, blocked attempts, leaks and invalid-oracle cases
metrics.corrections: append corrected version and old/new labels; retain every raw attempt
